purpose: Collects multi-line free text such as descriptions, comments and notes. Grows with its content up to ten lines, then scrolls.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown when empty; never a substitute for the label

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum characters; shows a live n/max count

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Value can be read and copied but not changed

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error below the field; sets the error state

whenToUse: For answers longer than one line: descriptions, comments, feedback
When the expected length varies widely
whenNotToUse: For formatted or rich text — use a rich-text editor
antiPatterns: Using a placeholder as the only instruction
Setting a tiny maxLength without showing the count

anatomy: Label above, multi-line field, helper text with an optional n/max count, error text with the report icon
sizes: Minimum `size-control-md` (40px) tall, the rows prop sets the minimum lines, grows to ten lines; padding `space-component-padding-sm` by `space-component-padding-field`
typography: Label `type-label-size`; value `type-body1-size`; helper, count and error `type-caption-size`
states: Border `color-border-input`, `color-border-input-hover` on hover; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring` with `color-border-interactive`; error `color-border-danger`; disabled at `opacity-disabled`
motion: Border colour over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Label is programmatically associated (React Aria wires label, description and error ids)
Error text is linked by aria-describedby and sets aria-invalid
Focus ring must be visible and use color-interactive-focus-ring
The character count is part of the description, so it is read with the field
